assessment: The empty ScienceCard omits a source-closed simulation relation. Lines 1608-1615 define a zero-average-treatment-effect setting with equal positive and negative context effects and explicitly state that the personalization effect psi equals Delta. Line 1623 reports the two evaluated Delta values 0.05 and 0.2, while lines 1615 and 1619 give the common simulation conditions. This supports a deterministic point predictor psi(Delta) = Delta on the numeric-value domain {0.05, 0.2}; the card therefore requires revision rather than source-level rejection.

issues.detail: The card omits the explicit relation personalization_effect = Delta over Delta in {0.05, 0.2}, with the zero-ATE simulation construction and fixed conditions reported at lines 1608-1623.
